figures.caption: Therapeutic indices of Smp24 and derived modifications. TI calculations of peptides against HepG2 (A), HEK293 (B), sheep erythrocytes (C), daptomycin against all cell lines (D) and polymyxin B against all cell lines (E). TIs of AMPs and PMB were calculated against E. coli. As daptomycin is only effective against Gram-positive isolates, its TI was calculated against S. aureus. Statistical significance of the difference between Smp24 and its derivatives was determined by performing a T-test on TI data and denoted by * equal to p-value < 0.05, ** p-value < 0.01, *** p-value < 0.001 and **** p-value < 0.0001.
